source.text: Περὶ δὲ τῶν πνευματικῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Concerning now the spiritual [things], brothers, not I want you to be ignorant.

en.L: Now concerning the spiritual [gifts], {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I do not want you to be ignorant.
en.B: Now about spiritual gifts, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}: I want you to be well informed.
en.R: Now, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I want to teach you about the gifts that the Spirit gives. I want you to understand them clearly.

fr.L: Or, au sujet des [dons] spirituels, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je ne veux pas que vous soyez dans l’ignorance.
fr.B: Venons-en aux dons spirituels, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} : je veux que vous soyez bien informés.
fr.R: Maintenant, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je veux vous enseigner au sujet des dons que l’Esprit accorde. Je veux que vous les compreniez bien.

es.L: Ahora bien, acerca de los [dones] espirituales, hermanos, no quiero que {{plural_you:ignoren|ignoréis}}.
es.B: En cuanto a los dones espirituales, hermanos, quiero que {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} bien informados.
es.R: Ahora, hermanos, quiero {{plural_you:enseñarles|enseñaros}} acerca de los dones que da el Espíritu. Quiero que los {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} bien.

sw.L: Basi kuhusu [karama] za kiroho, ndugu, sitaki mkose kujua.
sw.B: Basi kuhusu karama za kiroho, ndugu: nataka mfahamu vizuri.
sw.R: Sasa, ndugu, nataka kuwafundisha kuhusu karama ambazo Roho hutoa. Nataka mzielewe vizuri.

decisions.choice: now concerning: Paul takes up a new subject, probably one the Corinthians raised in their letter
decisions.reason: Περὶ δὲ opens a new topic, as at 7:1, 7:25 and 8:1. Chapters 12-14 all deal with this subject: what the Spirit gives and how it is used when the church meets.

decisions.choice: the spiritual things: the gifts that come from the Spirit
alternatives: spiritual people, those who have the Spirit's gifts
decisions.reason: τῶν πνευματικῶν can be neuter, "the spiritual things", or masculine, "the spiritual people". The neuter fits 14:1, where the same word clearly means gifts, and the subject of 12:4-11. The masculine fits 14:37 ("if anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual"), and some in Corinth may have claimed to be the spiritual ones (3:1). Either way the chapter is about the Spirit's gifts and those who use them.

decisions.choice: I do not want you to be ignorant: a formula Paul uses to introduce something important
decisions.reason: The same phrase opens new teaching in 10:1, Romans 1:13 and 1 Thessalonians 4:13. It is not a rebuke; it calls attention to what follows.

decisions.choice: the spiritual [gifts] (L); spiritual gifts (B); the gifts that the Spirit gives (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has only the adjective; the levels supply "gifts" as chosen in m2, and the footnote gives "spiritual people".

decisions.choice: I want you to be well informed (B); I want you to understand them clearly (R)
alternatives: I do not want you to be ignorant
I do not want you to be uninformed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say positively what the double negative means (m3); "ignorant" now sounds like an insult.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers (for chapters 11-13)
decisions.reason: As in English, Paul addresses the whole church, men and women; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: los [dones] espirituales (L); los dones espirituales (B); los dones que da el Espíritu (R)
decisions.reason: The word means the things that come from the Spirit (m2, footnoted). As the English, "dones espirituales" is said only here; the word for gift in verses 4-31 is "dones" alone, as in 7:7 and Romans 12:6.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 1:10, Spanish "hermanos" already includes the sisters, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: [karama] za kiroho (L); karama za kiroho (B); karama ambazo Roho hutoa (R)
decisions.reason: "Karama" is the settled word for charisma (1:7; 7:7; Romans 12:6), used again from verse 4; here the Greek has only "the spiritual [things]", so Literal brackets the noun.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: As in chapters 10-11: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters.

source.text: οἴδατε ὅτι ὅτε ἔθνη ἦτε πρὸς τὰ εἴδωλα τὰ ἄφωνα ὡς ἂν ἤγεσθε ἀπαγόμενοι.

records.literal_gloss: You know that when gentiles you were, to the idols the mute as ever you were led being led away.

en.L: You know that when you were Gentiles, [you were] led away to the mute idols, however you were led.
en.B: You know how it was when you were pagans: you were swept off to idols that cannot speak, carried away whichever way you were led.
en.R: You remember what your life was like before you believed. You were pulled this way and that, and you ended up worshiping idols that cannot even speak.

fr.L: Vous savez que, lorsque vous étiez des non-Juifs, [vous étiez] entraînés vers les idoles muettes, selon que vous étiez menés.
fr.B: Vous savez comment c’était quand vous étiez païens : vous étiez entraînés vers des idoles qui ne parlent pas, emportés là où l’on vous menait.
fr.R: Vous vous rappelez comment vous viviez avant de croire. Vous étiez tirés d’un côté et de l’autre, et vous avez fini par adorer des idoles qui ne peuvent même pas parler.

es.L: {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} que cuando {{plural_you:eran|erais}} gentiles, {{plural_you:eran|erais}} arrastrados hacia los ídolos mudos, como quiera que se {{plural_you:los|os}} llevara.
es.B: {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} cómo era cuando {{plural_you:eran|erais}} paganos: {{plural_you:se dejaban|os dejabais}} arrastrar hacia ídolos que no pueden hablar, llevados de un lado a otro.
es.R: {{plural_you:Recuerdan|Recordáis}} cómo era {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida antes de creer. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llevaban de un lado a otro, y {{plural_you:terminaban|terminabais}} adorando ídolos que ni siquiera pueden hablar.

sw.L: Mnajua kwamba mlipokuwa watu wa mataifa, [mlikuwa] mkichukuliwa kwenda kwa sanamu zisizoweza kusema, kwa namna yoyote mlivyoongozwa.
sw.B: Mnajua jinsi ilivyokuwa mlipokuwa wapagani: mlikokotwa kwenda kwa sanamu zisizoweza kusema, mkichukuliwa kokote mlikoongozwa.
sw.R: Mnakumbuka maisha yenu yalivyokuwa kabla hamjaamini. Mlivutwa huku na huko, mwishowe mkaishia kuabudu sanamu ambazo haziwezi hata kusema.

decisions.choice: gentiles: people outside God's people who worshiped other gods; pagans
alternatives: the nations, non-Jews as an ethnic group
decisions.reason: ἔθνη means the nations, people who are not Jews. Here Paul speaks of what the Corinthians were ("when you were"), as if they are no longer "gentiles": they still are not Jews, but they no longer live as people who do not know God (1 Thessalonians 4:5).

decisions.choice: however you were led: you were carried along again and again, by forces you did not control
alternatives: whenever you were led (on particular occasions such as festivals)
decisions.reason: ὡς ἂν with the imperfect ἤγεσθε describes something that happened repeatedly, and ἀπαγόμενοι ("being led away") is used for prisoners led off under guard. The sentence is broken in the Greek ("that when ... as you were led"), and Paul does not say who led them; 10:20 says that behind idols are demons.

decisions.choice: mute idols: idols that cannot speak
decisions.reason: The Scriptures mock idols that have mouths but cannot speak (Psalm 115:5; Habakkuk 2:18-19). The contrast prepares for verse 3: the Spirit of God does speak, through God's people.

decisions.choice: the Corinthians' former worship may have included ecstatic experiences
alternatives: the verse refers only to idol worship in general
decisions.reason: Some pagan cults in the Greek world, such as the worship of Dionysus, prized frenzied states in which a person felt seized by a god. If Paul has these in mind, his point is that being carried away is no proof of the Spirit; what is said about Jesus is (verse 3).

decisions.choice: pagans (B); before you believed (R)
decisions.reason: "Gentiles" would suggest only that they were not Jews; the point is that they worshiped idols (m1). Literal keeps "Gentiles".

decisions.choice: des non-Juifs (L)
decisions.reason: The style guide's Literal word for the Greek is "les nations", but French cannot say of a group of people "vous étiez des nations". Literal uses "non-Juifs", the guide's word where the English says "Gentiles"; Balanced says "païens" and Readable "avant de croire", as the English does, since the point is that they worshiped idols (m1).

decisions.choice: gentiles (L); paganos (B)
decisions.reason: The word here means people who worshiped other gods (m1). Literal keeps "gentiles"; Balanced says "paganos", the plain word for that, as the Spanish of this project does for pagans in the Gospels.

decisions.choice: watu wa mataifa (L); wapagani (B)
decisions.reason: The project's pair for ethne meaning people who worshiped other gods: "watu wa mataifa" (as 1:23) at Literal, "wapagani" at Balanced as the English says "pagans".

source.text: διὸ γνωρίζω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἐν πνεύματι θεοῦ λαλῶν λέγει· Ἀνάθεμα Ἰησοῦς, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται εἰπεῖν· Κύριος Ἰησοῦς εἰ μὴ ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I make known to you that no one by [the] Spirit of God speaking says, Accursed Jesus, and no one is able to say, Lord Jesus, except by [the] Spirit Holy.

en.L: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking by [the] Spirit of God says, "Jesus [is] accursed," and no one is able to say, "Jesus [is] Lord," except by [the] Holy Spirit.
en.B: That is why I am making this clear to you: nobody who speaks through God's Spirit ever says, "Jesus is cursed," and nobody can say, "Jesus is Lord," except through the Holy Spirit.
en.R: So I want you to understand this. When the Spirit of God is leading people to speak, they never say, "Jesus is cursed." And only the Holy Spirit can lead someone to say, "Jesus is Lord."

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je vous fais savoir que personne, parlant par l’Esprit de Dieu, ne dit : « Jésus [est] anathème », et que personne ne peut dire : « Jésus [est] Seigneur », si ce n’est par l’Esprit Saint.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi je tiens à vous le dire clairement : personne, s’il parle par l’Esprit de Dieu, ne dit jamais : « Jésus est maudit », et personne ne peut dire : « Jésus est Seigneur », si ce n’est par l’Esprit Saint.
fr.R: Je veux donc que vous compreniez ceci. Quand l’Esprit de Dieu conduit quelqu’un à parler, cette personne ne dit jamais : « Jésus est maudit. » Et seul l’Esprit Saint peut conduire quelqu’un à dire : « Jésus est Seigneur. »

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:les|os}} hago saber que nadie que habla por [el] Espíritu de Dios dice: «Jesús [es] maldito»; y nadie puede decir: «Jesús [es] Señor», sino por [el] Espíritu Santo.
es.B: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} dejo esto claro: nadie que habla por el Espíritu de Dios dice jamás: «Jesús es maldito»; y nadie puede decir: «Jesús es Señor», sino por el Espíritu Santo.
es.R: Así que quiero que {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} esto. Cuando el Espíritu de Dios guía a alguien a hablar, esa persona nunca dice: «Jesús es maldito». Y solo el Espíritu Santo puede guiar a alguien a decir: «Jesús es Señor».

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nawajulisha kwamba hakuna mtu anayesema katika Roho wa Mungu husema, "Yesu [ni] mlaaniwa," na hakuna mtu anayeweza kusema, "Yesu [ni] Bwana," isipokuwa katika Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana nawaeleza waziwazi: hakuna mtu anayesema kwa nguvu ya Roho wa Mungu ambaye kamwe husema, "Yesu amelaaniwa," na hakuna mtu anayeweza kusema, "Yesu ni Bwana," isipokuwa kwa nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nataka mwelewe jambo hili. Roho wa Mungu anapowaongoza watu kusema, kamwe hawasemi, "Yesu amelaaniwa." Na ni Roho Mtakatifu peke yake anayeweza kumwongoza mtu kusema, "Yesu ni Bwana."

decisions.choice: accursed: under God's curse, handed over to destruction
decisions.reason: Ἀνάθεμα is the word the Greek Old Testament uses for what is devoted to destruction (Deuteronomy 7:26). Paul uses it for one who is cut off and under God's curse (16:22; Romans 9:3; Galatians 1:8-9).

decisions.choice: who would cry "Jesus is accursed" is not known
alternatives: an outburst in ecstatic speech in the church
a demand made of believers in a synagogue or before a court
a statement Paul makes up to set beside the true confession
decisions.reason: Paul gives no setting. The cry may be invented to make the contrast sharp, or it may echo what Jesus' opponents said of one who was hanged on a tree (Galatians 3:13; Deuteronomy 21:23). His point is the same either way: speech that dishonors Jesus cannot come from God's Spirit, however inspired it sounds.

decisions.choice: Jesus is Lord: the basic confession of the Christian faith
decisions.reason: To say Κύριος Ἰησοῦς is to confess Jesus as the one with all authority (Romans 10:9; Philippians 2:11). The Greek Old Testament uses the same word for the God of Israel, so the confession puts Jesus where God alone belongs. No one makes it truly without the Spirit.

decisions.choice: by the Spirit: with the Spirit as the power at work in the speaker
alternatives: in the Spirit, in a state of inspiration
decisions.reason: ἐν πνεύματι can mean "by" or "in". The sense is that the Spirit moves the speaker; the test of whether the Spirit is at work is what is said about Jesus.

decisions.choice: Jesus [is] accursed / Jesus [is] Lord (L); Jesus is cursed / Jesus is Lord (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb in either saying. Both are read as statements; "Jesus be cursed" would make the first a wish, with much the same force.

decisions.choice: anathème (L); maudit (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word Paul uses, which French has taken over and which keeps the sense of being handed over to God's curse (m1); it is a learned word, so Balanced and Readable say "maudit", as the English says "cursed".

decisions.choice: l’Esprit Saint (for chapters 11-13)
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for the whole New Testament, as in John and Hebrews.

decisions.choice: maldito
decisions.reason: The word means under God's curse (m1). "Maldito" says this in everyday Spanish; "anatema" is a church word most readers would not know.

decisions.choice: kwa nguvu ya Roho
decisions.reason: "Katika Roho" alone is unclear in Swahili; Balanced says the Spirit is the power at work in the speaker, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: Διαιρέσεις δὲ χαρισμάτων εἰσίν, τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα·

records.literal_gloss: Distributions now of gifts there are, but the same Spirit;

en.L: Now there are distributions of gifts, but the same Spirit.
en.B: Gifts are given out in different ways, but it is the same Spirit who gives them.
en.R: The Spirit gives different gifts to different people, but it is always the same Spirit.

fr.L: Or il y a des répartitions de dons, mais le même Esprit ;
fr.B: Les dons sont répartis de différentes manières, mais c’est le même Esprit qui les donne.
fr.R: L’Esprit donne différents dons à différentes personnes, mais c’est toujours le même Esprit.

es.L: Ahora bien, hay distribuciones de dones, pero el mismo Espíritu;
es.B: Los dones se reparten de distintas maneras, pero es el mismo Espíritu quien los da.
es.R: El Espíritu da dones diferentes a personas diferentes, pero siempre es el mismo Espíritu.

sw.L: Basi kuna migawanyo ya karama, lakini Roho ni yule yule.
sw.B: Karama hugawanywa kwa namna mbalimbali, lakini ni Roho yule yule anayezitoa.
sw.R: Roho huwapa watu mbalimbali karama tofauti, lakini daima ni Roho yule yule.

decisions.choice: distributions: different gifts, given out to different people
decisions.reason: Διαιρέσεις can mean dividing out or allotting, and also the differences that result. The verb from the same root in verse 11 ("distributing to each") shows that the giving out is in view, and the list in verses 8-10 shows the variety.

decisions.choice: gifts: things given freely by God's grace
decisions.reason: χαρισμάτων is formed from the word for grace and means a gift of grace. In this chapter it names what the Spirit gives each believer for the good of all (verse 7). Paul uses the same word in 1:7 and 7:7, and it runs through chapters 12-14.

decisions.choice: the same Spirit: one giver behind every gift
decisions.reason: Verses 4-6 say the same thing three times: the gifts differ, the giver is one. The point answers a church divided over whose gift was best.

decisions.choice: gifts (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is rendered "gifts" at every level in chapters 12-14, so that readers can follow it; m2 notes its link with grace. 1:7 brings out that link in Balanced ("gift of grace"), where Paul has just spoken of grace.

decisions.choice: it is the same Spirit who gives them (B); it is always the same Spirit (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb in the second half; Balanced and Readable supply what the contrast implies.

decisions.choice: les dons (every level, chapters 12-14); les dons spirituels for verse 1
decisions.reason: As in English, the word is kept the same at every level so that readers can follow it through chapters 12-14. "Charismes" is a church word that most readers would not know, and "dons spirituels" is kept for the different Greek word of verse 1.

decisions.choice: dones
decisions.reason: As recorded at 7:7, "don" is the Spanish word for a gift of God's grace, as in Romans 12:6, and it is kept through chapters 12-14 at every level, as the English keeps "gifts".

decisions.choice: karama
decisions.reason: "Karama" for charisma at every level through chapters 12-14, as 1:7; "kipawa" is kept for dorea (a gift) elsewhere.

source.text: καὶ διαιρέσεις διακονιῶν εἰσιν, καὶ ὁ αὐτὸς κύριος·

records.literal_gloss: and distributions of ministries there are, and the same Lord;

en.L: And there are distributions of ministries, and the same Lord.
en.B: Ministries are given out in different ways, and it is the same Lord who is served.
en.R: There are different ways to serve, but we all serve the same Lord.

fr.L: et il y a des répartitions de ministères, et le même Seigneur ;
fr.B: Les ministères sont répartis de différentes manières, et c’est le même Seigneur que l’on sert.
fr.R: Il y a différentes façons de servir, mais nous servons tous le même Seigneur.

es.L: y hay distribuciones de ministerios, y el mismo Señor;
es.B: Los ministerios se reparten de distintas maneras, y es el mismo Señor a quien se sirve.
es.R: Hay diferentes maneras de servir, pero todos servimos al mismo Señor.

sw.L: Na kuna migawanyo ya huduma, na Bwana ni yule yule.
sw.B: Huduma hugawanywa kwa namna mbalimbali, na ni Bwana yule yule anayetumikiwa.
sw.R: Kuna njia tofauti za kuhudumu, lakini sote tunamtumikia Bwana yule yule.

decisions.choice: ministries: ways of serving others
decisions.reason: διακονιῶν is service, work done for the good of others. Paul uses it for his own work as an apostle (2 Corinthians 4:1) and for practical help (16:15). The gifts are given to serve.

decisions.choice: the same Lord: Jesus Christ, whom all serve
decisions.reason: In this letter "Lord" alone usually means Jesus (8:6; 12:3). Whatever form the service takes, it is service to one Lord.

decisions.choice: it is the same Lord who is served (B); we all serve the same Lord (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb; Balanced and Readable say how the Lord is related to the ministries.

decisions.choice: ministerios (L, B); maneras de servir (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Corinthians 3 in Spanish, the noun of the "servidores" family is "ministerio" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "servir", as the English says "ways to serve".

source.text: καὶ διαιρέσεις ἐνεργημάτων εἰσίν, ὁ δὲ αὐτὸς θεός, ὁ ἐνεργῶν τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: and distributions of workings there are, but the same God, the [one] working the all things in all.

en.L: And there are distributions of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.
en.B: Workings of power are given out in different ways, but it is the same God who works all of them in everyone.
en.R: God's power works in different ways, but it is the same God who does all these things in every one of us.

fr.L: et il y a des répartitions d’opérations, mais le même Dieu, qui opère tout en tous.
fr.B: Les œuvres de puissance sont réparties de différentes manières, mais c’est le même Dieu qui les accomplit toutes en chacun.
fr.R: La puissance de Dieu agit de différentes façons, mais c’est le même Dieu qui fait tout cela en chacun de nous.

es.L: y hay distribuciones de operaciones, pero el mismo Dios, que obra todas las cosas en todos.
es.B: Las obras del poder de Dios se reparten de distintas maneras, pero es el mismo Dios quien las realiza todas en todos.
es.R: El poder de Dios actúa de diferentes maneras, pero es el mismo Dios quien hace todas estas cosas en cada uno de nosotros.

sw.L: Na kuna migawanyo ya utendaji, lakini Mungu ni yule yule, atendaye yote katika wote.
sw.B: Utendaji wa nguvu za Mungu hugawanywa kwa namna mbalimbali, lakini ni Mungu yule yule anayetenda yote hayo ndani ya kila mtu.
sw.R: Nguvu ya Mungu hufanya kazi kwa njia tofauti, lakini ni Mungu yule yule anayefanya mambo haya yote ndani ya kila mmoja wetu.

decisions.choice: workings: what God's power produces, things done by his power at work
decisions.reason: ἐνεργημάτων is related to the verb ἐνεργῶν ("working") in the same verse. It names the results of God's power at work; verse 10 uses it for miracles.

decisions.choice: in all: in every believer
decisions.reason: πᾶσιν can be masculine or neuter. Verse 7, "to each", suggests people: God is at work in every member of the church.

decisions.choice: Spirit, Lord and God: one God at work in three persons
decisions.reason: Verses 4-6 name the Spirit, the Lord Jesus and God the Father side by side as the source of the gifts, as 2 Corinthians 13:13 does in a blessing. Paul is not teaching about the Trinity here, but his words assume it.

decisions.choice: workings of power
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out that these are the results of power at work (m1); Readable says "God's power works".

decisions.choice: utendaji
decisions.reason: "Utendaji" (workings) for energemata, from the same root as "atendaye" (who works), as in the Greek; "matendo ya nguvu" is kept for dynameis (miracles) in verses 10 and 28.

source.text: ἑκάστῳ δὲ δίδοται ἡ φανέρωσις τοῦ πνεύματος πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον.

records.literal_gloss: To each now is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the benefiting.

en.L: Now to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for [what is] beneficial.
en.B: Each person is given a way in which the Spirit is openly at work, and it is given for the good of all.
en.R: In each one of us the Spirit is at work in a way that others can see. God gives this to help the whole church.

fr.L: Or à chacun est donnée la manifestation de l’Esprit en vue de [ce qui est] utile.
fr.B: À chacun est donnée une manière dont l’Esprit agit au grand jour, et c’est pour le bien de tous.
fr.R: En chacun de nous, l’Esprit agit d’une manière que les autres peuvent voir. Dieu nous donne cela pour aider toute l’Église.

es.L: Ahora bien, a cada uno le es dada la manifestación del Espíritu para el provecho [común].
es.B: A cada uno se le da una manera en que el Espíritu actúa a la vista de todos, y se le da para el bien de todos.
es.R: En cada uno de nosotros el Espíritu actúa de una manera que los demás pueden ver. Dios nos da esto para ayudar a toda la iglesia.

sw.L: Lakini kila mmoja hupewa udhihirisho wa Roho kwa ajili ya [kile kinachofaa].
sw.B: Kila mtu amepewa njia ambayo kwayo Roho anaonekana wazi akitenda kazi, naye amepewa kwa ajili ya faida ya wote.
sw.R: Ndani ya kila mmoja wetu Roho anafanya kazi kwa namna ambayo wengine wanaweza kuiona. Mungu hutupa jambo hili ili kulisaidia kanisa zima.

decisions.choice: the manifestation of the Spirit: the Spirit made visible, shown to be present and at work
decisions.reason: τοῦ πνεύματος can be the one who is shown or the one who shows. Since the list that follows describes gifts in which the Spirit's presence becomes evident, the Spirit is the one made known.

decisions.choice: for the benefit of all: given to do good to the church, not for the one who has it
alternatives: for what is profitable to the person
decisions.reason: τὸ συμφέρον means what is useful or brings benefit. In this letter the benefit is that of the church (10:23-24, 33; 14:3-5, 12).

decisions.choice: is given to each: God gives, and every believer receives
decisions.reason: δίδοται is passive, with God as the giver (verse 18; verse 28). ἑκάστῳ means each one: no believer is left out.

decisions.choice: a way in which the Spirit is openly at work (B); the Spirit is at work in a way that others can see (R)
decisions.reason: "Manifestation" is a hard word; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: God gives this to help the whole church
decisions.reason: Readable names the giver (m3) and says whose good is meant (m2).

source.text: ᾧ μὲν γὰρ διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος δίδοται λόγος σοφίας, ἄλλῳ δὲ λόγος γνώσεως κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα, ἑτέρῳ πίστις ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ πνεύματι, ἄλλῳ χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ πνεύματι, ἄλλῳ ἐνεργήματα δυνάμεων, ἄλλῳ προφητεία, ἄλλῳ διακρίσεις πνευμάτων, ἑτέρῳ γένη γλωσσῶν, ἄλλῳ ἑρμηνεία γλωσσῶν·

records.literal_gloss: To one for through the Spirit is given a word of wisdom, to another and a word of knowledge according to the same Spirit, \v 9 to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healings by the one Spirit, \v 10 to another workings of powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishings of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, to another interpretation of tongues;

en.L: For to one is given through the Spirit a word of wisdom, and to another a word of knowledge according to the same Spirit, \v 9 to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healings by the one Spirit, \v 10 to another workings of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing of spirits, to another kinds of tongues, to another interpretation of tongues.
en.B: Through the Spirit one person is given a message of wisdom; another, by the same Spirit, a message of knowledge; \v 9 another, by the same Spirit, faith; another, by the one Spirit, gifts of healing; \v 10 another, the power to work miracles; another, prophecy; another, the ability to tell spirits apart; another, different kinds of tongues; and another, the interpretation of tongues.
en.R: The Spirit helps one person speak with wisdom. The same Spirit helps another person speak with knowledge. \v 9 The same Spirit gives one person a special gift of faith, and gives another person gifts to heal people. \v 10 One person has the power to do miracles. Another can prophesy. Another can tell which spirits are from God and which are not. One person can speak in different kinds of tongues, and another can interpret what is said in tongues.

fr.L: Car à l’un est donnée par l’Esprit une parole de sagesse, à un autre une parole de connaissance selon le même Esprit, \v 9 à un autre la foi par le même Esprit, à un autre des dons de guérisons par l’unique Esprit, \v 10 à un autre des opérations de miracles, à un autre la prophétie, à un autre le discernement des esprits, à un autre diverses sortes de langues, à un autre l’interprétation des langues.
fr.B: Par l’Esprit, l’un reçoit un message de sagesse ; un autre, par le même Esprit, un message de connaissance ; \v 9 un autre, par le même Esprit, la foi ; un autre, par l’unique Esprit, des dons de guérison ; \v 10 un autre, le pouvoir de faire des miracles ; un autre, la prophétie ; un autre, la capacité de distinguer les esprits ; un autre, différentes sortes de langues ; et un autre encore, l’interprétation des langues.
fr.R: L’Esprit aide une personne à parler avec sagesse. Le même Esprit aide une autre personne à parler avec connaissance. \v 9 Le même Esprit donne à quelqu’un un don particulier de foi, et à quelqu’un d’autre des dons pour guérir les malades. \v 10 L’un a le pouvoir de faire des miracles. Un autre peut prophétiser. Un autre peut reconnaître quels esprits viennent de Dieu et lesquels n’en viennent pas. L’un peut parler en différentes sortes de langues, et un autre peut interpréter ce qui est dit en langues.

es.L: Porque a uno se le da por medio del Espíritu palabra de sabiduría, y a otro palabra de conocimiento según el mismo Espíritu, \v 9 a otro fe por el mismo Espíritu, a otro dones de sanidades por el único Espíritu, \v 10 a otro operaciones de milagros, a otro profecía, a otro discernimiento de espíritus, a otro géneros de lenguas, a otro interpretación de lenguas.
es.B: Por medio del Espíritu, a uno se le da un mensaje de sabiduría; a otro, por el mismo Espíritu, un mensaje de conocimiento; \v 9 a otro, por el mismo Espíritu, fe; a otro, por el único Espíritu, dones de sanidad; \v 10 a otro, el poder de hacer milagros; a otro, profecía; a otro, la capacidad de distinguir los espíritus; a otro, diversas clases de lenguas; y a otro, la interpretación de lenguas.
es.R: El Espíritu ayuda a una persona a hablar con sabiduría. El mismo Espíritu ayuda a otra persona a hablar con conocimiento. \v 9 El mismo Espíritu da a una persona un don especial de fe, y a otra le da dones para sanar a la gente. \v 10 Una persona tiene el poder de hacer milagros. Otra puede profetizar. Otra puede distinguir qué espíritus vienen de Dios y cuáles no. Una persona puede hablar en diversas clases de lenguas, y otra puede interpretar lo que se dice en lenguas.

sw.L: Kwa maana mmoja hupewa kupitia Roho neno la hekima, na mwingine neno la maarifa kwa kadiri ya Roho yule yule, \v 9 mwingine imani katika Roho yule yule, mwingine karama za uponyaji katika Roho yule mmoja, \v 10 mwingine utendaji wa matendo ya nguvu, mwingine unabii, mwingine kupambanua roho, mwingine aina za lugha, mwingine tafsiri ya lugha.
sw.B: Kupitia Roho, mtu mmoja hupewa ujumbe wa hekima; mwingine, kwa Roho yule yule, ujumbe wa maarifa; \v 9 mwingine, kwa Roho yule yule, imani; mwingine, kwa Roho yule mmoja, karama za uponyaji; \v 10 mwingine, uwezo wa kufanya matendo ya nguvu; mwingine, unabii; mwingine, uwezo wa kupambanua roho; mwingine, aina mbalimbali za lugha; na mwingine, tafsiri ya lugha.
sw.R: Roho humsaidia mtu mmoja kusema kwa hekima. Roho huyo huyo humsaidia mtu mwingine kusema kwa maarifa. \v 9 Roho huyo huyo humpa mtu mmoja karama maalum ya imani, na humpa mwingine karama za kuwaponya watu. \v 10 Mtu mmoja ana uwezo wa kufanya miujiza. Mwingine anaweza kutoa unabii. Mwingine anaweza kutambua roho zipi zinatoka kwa Mungu na zipi hazitoki kwa Mungu. Mtu mmoja anaweza kunena kwa aina mbalimbali za lugha, na mwingine anaweza kufasiri yale yanayosemwa kwa lugha hizo.

decisions.choice: a word of wisdom, a word of knowledge: speech given by the Spirit that brings God's wisdom or knowledge to others
alternatives: wisdom and knowledge as qualities of mind
decisions.reason: λόγος shows these are gifts of speaking. Paul has contrasted human wisdom with the wisdom the Spirit reveals (2:6-13), and knowledge was prized in Corinth (8:1). He does not define how the two gifts differ.

decisions.choice: faith: a particular gift of faith, confidence that God will act in a given situation
alternatives: the faith that saves, which every believer has
decisions.reason: Every believer has saving faith, but this is given only to some. It is probably the faith that "moves mountains" (13:2; Mark 11:22-23).

decisions.choice: gifts of healings, workings of miracles: each healing and each miracle is itself a gift
decisions.reason: Both nouns are plural in each pair. δυνάμεων are acts of power, miracles (2 Corinthians 12:12; Galatians 3:5).

decisions.choice: prophecy: speaking a message from God for the church
decisions.reason: In chapter 14 prophecy builds up, encourages and comforts the church (14:3) and lays bare the secrets of the heart (14:24-25). It may include prediction (Acts 11:28) but is not limited to it.

decisions.choice: distinguishing of spirits: telling whether a spiritual utterance comes from God's Spirit or from another spirit
decisions.reason: The church was to test what was spoken under inspiration (14:29; 1 Thessalonians 5:20-21; 1 John 4:1). Verses 2-3 have just shown that not every inspired utterance comes from God.

decisions.choice: tongues: speech given by the Spirit in a language the speaker has not learned
alternatives: speech that is not any human language
decisions.reason: γλωσσῶν means both the tongue and a language. At Pentecost hearers recognized their own languages (Acts 2:4-11). In Corinth no one understood a tongue unless it was interpreted (14:2, 27-28), and Paul speaks of "tongues of angels" (13:1). "Kinds" of tongues may cover both.

decisions.choice: interpretation: putting into understandable words what was said in a tongue
alternatives: translation from one human language to another
decisions.reason: In chapter 14 interpretation lets the whole church understand and be built up by a tongue (14:5, 13, 27-28). It too is a gift of the Spirit.

decisions.choice: through, according to, by the one Spirit: every gift has the same source
decisions.reason: Paul varies the prepositions but says one thing: the Spirit gives them all (verse 11).

decisions.choice: names of the gifts: word of wisdom / knowledge (L), message of wisdom / knowledge (B); gifts of healing; workings of miracles (L), the power to work miracles (B); prophecy; distinguishing of spirits (L), the ability to tell spirits apart (B); kinds of tongues (L), different kinds of tongues (B); interpretation of tongues
decisions.reason: These names are kept wherever the gifts come back (12:28-30; chapters 13-14). "Message" makes clear that the first two are gifts of speaking (m1). "Tongues" keeps the one word Paul uses for the tongue and for speech; the footnote gives "languages" (m6).

decisions.choice: a special gift of faith; which spirits are from God and which are not
decisions.reason: Readable says that this faith is not the faith every believer has (m2), and what telling spirits apart means (m5).

decisions.choice: names of the gifts: parole de sagesse / de connaissance (L), message de sagesse / de connaissance (B); dons de guérison(s); opérations de miracles (L), le pouvoir de faire des miracles (B); la prophétie; le discernement des esprits (L), la capacité de distinguer les esprits (B); diverses / différentes sortes de langues; l’interprétation des langues (for chapters 12-14)
decisions.reason: These names are kept wherever the gifts come back (12:28-30; chapters 13-14), as in English. French "langue" means both the tongue and a language, as the Greek word does, so "parler en langues" keeps Paul's one word without deciding what kind of speech it was (m6).

decisions.choice: palabra de sabiduría, palabra de conocimiento, dones de sanidades, operaciones de milagros, profecía, discernimiento de espíritus, géneros de lenguas, interpretación de lenguas (L); mensaje de sabiduría, mensaje de conocimiento, dones de sanidad, el poder de hacer milagros, profecía, la capacidad de distinguir los espíritus, diversas clases de lenguas, la interpretación de lenguas (B)
decisions.reason: The names of the gifts follow the English names of docs/corinthians-terms.md, and chapters 12-14 keep them. "Conocimiento" is the word of chapter 8. "Lenguas" is kept, as in Acts 2, 10 and 19 in Spanish; the meaning decision notes "languages" (m6, footnoted).

decisions.choice: profetizar
alternatives: comunicar mensajes de parte de Dios
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "profetizar", explained in 11:4 as speaking a message from God, so the gift keeps its name through chapter 14.

decisions.choice: neno la hekima, neno la maarifa (L) / ujumbe wa hekima, ujumbe wa maarifa (B); karama za uponyaji; matendo ya nguvu (L, B) / miujiza (R); unabii; kupambanua roho (L) / uwezo wa kupambanua roho (B); tafsiri ya lugha
decisions.reason: The names of the gifts, kept the same through chapters 12-14. "Kupambanua" is the verb used for discerning the body in 11:29, from the same Greek root; "roho" is lowercase here because the spirits behind an utterance may or may not be God's Spirit.

decisions.choice: lugha; kunena kwa lugha
decisions.reason: "Kunena kwa lugha" is the usual Swahili name for the gift, as in Acts 10:46, and keeps the link with known languages (footnoted in the meaning decision); "ndimi" (tongues, the body part) is the more literal word, kept in Mark 16:17. A native reviewer should confirm.

source.text: πάντα δὲ ταῦτα ἐνεργεῖ τὸ ἓν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα, διαιροῦν ἰδίᾳ ἑκάστῳ καθὼς βούλεται.

records.literal_gloss: All now these works the one and the same Spirit, distributing individually to each as he wills.

en.L: But all these [things] the one and the same Spirit works, distributing to each one individually as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wills.
en.B: One and the same Spirit is at work in all of these, giving to each person separately as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chooses.
en.R: It is the one Spirit who does all these things. The Spirit decides which gifts to give to each person.

fr.L: Mais toutes ces choses, c’est l’unique et même Esprit qui les opère, distribuant à chacun en particulier comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut.
fr.B: C’est un seul et même Esprit qui est à l’œuvre dans tout cela, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne à chacun en particulier comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le décide.
fr.R: C’est le seul Esprit qui fait toutes ces choses. L’Esprit décide quels dons donner à chaque personne.

es.L: Pero todas estas cosas las obra el uno y mismo Espíritu, repartiendo a cada uno en particular como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere.
es.B: Uno y el mismo Espíritu actúa en todo esto, y da a cada persona por separado según {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} decide.
es.R: Es el único Espíritu quien hace todas estas cosas. El Espíritu decide qué dones dar a cada persona.

sw.L: Lakini haya yote Roho yule mmoja na yule yule huyatenda, akimgawia kila mmoja peke yake kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} apendavyo.
sw.B: Roho mmoja, yule yule, ndiye anayetenda kazi katika haya yote, akimpa kila mtu kivyake kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anavyochagua.
sw.R: Ni Roho mmoja anayefanya mambo haya yote. Roho ndiye anayeamua karama gani ampe kila mtu.

decisions.choice: works: the Spirit does what verse 6 says God does
decisions.reason: ἐνεργεῖ repeats the verb of verse 6, where God "works all things in all". The Spirit is the one through whom God works.

decisions.choice: as he wills: the Spirit chooses, freely, which gift each person receives
alternatives: the gifts are given according to what each person wants or deserves
decisions.reason: βούλεται is a verb of willing and deciding, used of persons. The Spirit is not a force but acts with a will of his own. No one can boast about a gift, and no one should despise a gift as lesser (4:7).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}
decisions.reason: The Spirit is a person and is never "it"; the pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting. Readable repeats "the Spirit".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} for the Spirit
decisions.reason: As in English, the Spirit takes the deity_pronoun setting like God and Christ; French "Esprit" is masculine, so the pronoun is "il" in any case. Balanced needs a second pronoun for the verb French supplies ("{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne").

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}
decisions.reason: The Holy Spirit takes the deity_pronoun setting like God and Christ (docs/corinthians-terms.md), and is never "it"; Spanish "él" agrees with "Espíritu" and names a person.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}
decisions.reason: The Holy Spirit takes the deity_pronoun span like God and Christ, here on the free pronoun "yeye"; the Spirit is always given personal agreement (anayetenda, apendavyo), never treated as a thing.

source.text: Καθάπερ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα ἕν ἐστιν καὶ μέλη πολλὰ ἔχει, πάντα δὲ τὰ μέλη τοῦ σώματος πολλὰ ὄντα ἕν ἐστιν σῶμα, οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός·

records.literal_gloss: Just as for the body one is and members many has, all but the members of the body many being one are body, so also the Christ;

en.L: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, many as they are, are one body, so also [is] the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: A body is a single whole, and yet it has many parts; all its parts, many as they are, make up one body. It is the same with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: A body is one thing, but it has many parts. It has many parts, but together they make one body. It is the same with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

fr.L: Car, de même que le corps est un et a beaucoup de membres, et que tous les membres du corps, malgré leur nombre, sont un seul corps, ainsi en est-il aussi du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Le corps forme un tout, et pourtant il a beaucoup de parties ; toutes ses parties, si nombreuses soient-elles, forment un seul corps. Il en est de même du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Un corps est une seule chose, mais il a beaucoup de parties. Il a beaucoup de parties, mais ensemble elles forment un seul corps. C’est la même chose pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

es.L: Porque así como el cuerpo es uno y tiene muchos miembros, y todos los miembros del cuerpo, siendo muchos, son un solo cuerpo, así también el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: El cuerpo es una sola unidad, y sin embargo tiene muchas partes; y todas sus partes, aunque son muchas, forman un solo cuerpo. Así es también con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: Un cuerpo es una sola cosa, pero tiene muchas partes. Tiene muchas partes, pero juntas forman un solo cuerpo. Así es también con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile mwili ni mmoja na una viungo vingi, na viungo vyote vya mwili, ingawa ni vingi, ni mwili mmoja, ndivyo alivyo {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} pia.
sw.B: Mwili ni kitu kimoja kizima, lakini una sehemu nyingi; sehemu zake zote, ingawa ni nyingi, zinaunda mwili mmoja. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Mwili ni kitu kimoja, lakini una sehemu nyingi. Una sehemu nyingi, lakini kwa pamoja zinaunda mwili mmoja. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

decisions.choice: members: the parts of a body, limbs and organs
decisions.reason: μέλη are the parts of a body, as in 6:15. The picture is physical throughout verses 12-26.

decisions.choice: so also is Christ: Christ is one with his people, who are his body
decisions.reason: Paul might have said "so also is the church"; he says "Christ". The church is Christ's own body (verse 27; 6:15; Ephesians 1:22-23), and in it Christ is present.

decisions.choice: the body as a picture of a community was familiar in the ancient world
decisions.reason: Greek and Roman writers used the body to urge citizens to keep their place for the good of the state; Livy tells such a fable of the Roman people (2.32). Paul uses the picture to say that every part matters and needs the others.

decisions.choice: parts (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:15: "members" now usually means members of a club, so Balanced and Readable keep the picture of a body (m1). Literal keeps "members".

decisions.choice: Christ and his people
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Christ is meant together with those who belong to him (m2).

decisions.choice: les membres (L); les parties (B, R) (for chapter 12)
decisions.reason: French "membre" is still said of the body, but it means a limb, and Paul's list includes the eye, the ear and the head; Balanced and Readable say "parties", as the English says "parts". Literal keeps "membres", which also keeps the link with members of the church.

decisions.choice: miembros (L); partes (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 6:15 and Romans 12:4 in Spanish: Literal keeps "miembros", and Balanced and Readable say "partes", as the English says "parts", through the chapter.

decisions.choice: viungo (L); sehemu (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 6:15 and Romans 12:4: "viungo" (limbs, members) at Literal, "sehemu" (parts) at Balanced and Readable, through verse 27.

source.text: καὶ γὰρ ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι ἡμεῖς πάντες εἰς ἓν σῶμα ἐβαπτίσθημεν, εἴτε Ἰουδαῖοι εἴτε Ἕλληνες, εἴτε δοῦλοι εἴτε ἐλεύθεροι, καὶ πάντες ἓν πνεῦμα ἐποτίσθημεν.

records.literal_gloss: Also for in one Spirit we all into one body were baptized, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and all one Spirit were made to drink.

en.L: For indeed in one Spirit we all were baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and all were given one Spirit to drink.
en.B: Indeed, all of us were baptized in one Spirit into one body, whether we were Jews or Greeks, slaves or free, and all of us were given one Spirit to drink.
en.R: It does not matter whether we are Jews or Greeks, slaves or free. All of us were baptized in the one Spirit, and that made us one body. God gave every one of us the same Spirit, like water to drink.

fr.L: Car en effet, dans un seul Esprit, nous tous, nous avons été baptisés en un seul corps, soit Juifs, soit Grecs, soit esclaves, soit libres, et nous avons tous été abreuvés d’un seul Esprit.
fr.B: Oui, nous avons tous été baptisés dans un seul Esprit pour former un seul corps, que nous soyons Juifs ou Grecs, esclaves ou libres, et on nous a tous donné à boire un seul et même Esprit.
fr.R: Peu importe que nous soyons Juifs ou Grecs, esclaves ou libres. Nous avons tous été baptisés dans le seul Esprit, et cela a fait de nous un seul corps. Dieu nous a donné à tous le même Esprit, comme de l’eau à boire.

es.L: Porque también en un solo Espíritu todos nosotros fuimos bautizados en un solo cuerpo, ya judíos o griegos, ya esclavos o libres, y a todos se nos dio a beber un solo Espíritu.
es.B: En efecto, todos fuimos bautizados en un solo Espíritu para formar un solo cuerpo, fuéramos judíos o griegos, esclavos o libres, y a todos se nos dio a beber un solo Espíritu.
es.R: No importa si somos judíos o griegos, esclavos o libres. Todos fuimos bautizados en el único Espíritu, y eso nos hizo un solo cuerpo. Dios nos dio a cada uno el mismo Espíritu, como agua para beber.

sw.L: Kwa maana katika Roho mmoja sisi sote tulibatizwa kuingia katika mwili mmoja, kama ni Wayahudi au Wagiriki, kama ni watumwa au walio huru, na sote tulinyweshwa Roho mmoja.
sw.B: Kwa kweli, sisi sote tulibatizwa katika Roho mmoja tukawa mwili mmoja, tukiwa Wayahudi au Wagiriki, watumwa au watu huru, na sote tulipewa Roho mmoja tumnywe.
sw.R: Haijalishi kama sisi ni Wayahudi au Wagiriki, watumwa au watu huru. Sote tulibatizwa katika Roho yule mmoja, na hilo likatufanya kuwa mwili mmoja. Mungu alimpa kila mmoja wetu Roho yule yule, kama maji ya kunywa.

decisions.choice: in one Spirit: the Spirit is the one in whom believers are baptized, as water is in baptism
alternatives: by one Spirit, the Spirit doing the baptizing
decisions.reason: ἐν can mean "in" or "by". John the Baptist said that the one coming would baptize "in the Holy Spirit" (Mark 1:8), with the Spirit as the element. "By" would make the Spirit the one who baptizes. Either way the Spirit unites believers into one body.

decisions.choice: baptized into one body: joined to Christ's body when they received the Spirit, the event that baptism marks
decisions.reason: "We all" were baptized: Paul speaks of what is true of every believer, not of some. Water baptism goes with it (Galatians 3:27-28; Romans 6:3), but the stress here is on the Spirit's work.

decisions.choice: Jews and Greeks, slaves and free: the deepest divisions of the ancient world, overcome in the one body
decisions.reason: "Greeks" means people who were not Jews. A slave was the legal property of another; the church in Corinth had both slaves and free people (7:21-22). Compare Galatians 3:28 and Colossians 3:11.

decisions.choice: made to drink: given the Spirit, as water is given to the thirsty or to dry ground
decisions.reason: ἐποτίσθημεν means to give drink or to water a field (3:6-8). The prophets promised that God would pour out his Spirit like water (Isaiah 32:15; 44:3), and Jesus spoke of the Spirit as living water (John 7:37-39). The two halves of the verse probably describe one event.

decisions.choice: were given one Spirit to drink (B); gave every one of us the same Spirit, like water to drink (R)
alternatives: were made to drink of one Spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the picture of drinking and make it clear that the Spirit is given (m4).

decisions.choice: the list of Jews and Greeks, slaves and free comes first
decisions.reason: Readable starts with the differences, so that the point, one body, comes last.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it in "slave or free" lists: the verse sets slave against free (m3).

decisions.choice: esclavos
decisions.reason: Slave is set against free, so slavery itself is the point and every level says "esclavos", as in 7:21-23.

decisions.choice: watumwa
decisions.reason: "Mtumwa" at every level where slavery itself is meant, slave beside free, as in 7:21-23.

source.text: Καὶ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα οὐκ ἔστιν ἓν μέλος ἀλλὰ πολλά.

records.literal_gloss: Also for the body not is one member but many.

en.L: For indeed the body is not one member but many.
en.B: After all, a body does not consist of one part. It has many.
en.R: A body is not just one part. It has many parts.

fr.L: Car en effet, le corps n’est pas un seul membre, mais plusieurs.
fr.B: Après tout, un corps n’est pas fait d’une seule partie. Il en a beaucoup.
fr.R: Un corps n’a pas une seule partie. Il a beaucoup de parties.

es.L: Porque también el cuerpo no es un solo miembro, sino muchos.
es.B: Después de todo, el cuerpo no consta de una sola parte, sino de muchas.
es.R: Un cuerpo no es solo una parte. Tiene muchas partes.

sw.L: Kwa maana mwili pia si kiungo kimoja, bali vingi.
sw.B: Kwa kweli, mwili haukuundwa na sehemu moja tu. Una sehemu nyingi.
sw.R: Mwili si sehemu moja tu. Una sehemu nyingi.

decisions.choice: for indeed: Paul begins to explain the picture of verse 12
decisions.reason: Καὶ γὰρ introduces verses 15-26, which work out what it means for one body to have many parts.

decisions.choice: part (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12, "part" keeps the picture of a body; Literal says "member".

source.text: ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ πούς· Ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ χείρ, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος, οὐ παρὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σώματος;

records.literal_gloss: If should say the foot, Because not I am hand, not I am of the body, not because of this not is it of the body?

en.L: If the foot should say, "Because I am not a hand, I am not of the body," it is not for that reason not of the body, [is it]?
en.B: Suppose the foot says, "I am not a hand, so I do not belong to the body." Would it belong to the body any less for that?
en.R: Suppose the foot said, "I am not a hand, so I am not part of the body." It would still be part of the body!

fr.L: Si le pied dit : « Parce que je ne suis pas une main, je ne suis pas du corps », il n’en est pas moins du corps pour autant, [n’est-ce pas] ?
fr.B: Supposons que le pied dise : « Je ne suis pas une main, donc je ne fais pas partie du corps. » En ferait-il moins partie du corps pour autant ?
fr.R: Imaginez que le pied dise : « Je ne suis pas une main, alors je ne fais pas partie du corps. » Il ferait quand même partie du corps !

es.L: Si dijera el pie: «Porque no soy mano, no soy del cuerpo», ¿no por eso deja de ser del cuerpo?
es.B: Supongamos que el pie dijera: «Como no soy mano, no pertenezco al cuerpo». ¿Dejaría por eso de pertenecer al cuerpo?
es.R: Supongamos que el pie dijera: «No soy una mano, así que no soy parte del cuerpo». ¡Seguiría siendo parte del cuerpo!

sw.L: Mguu ukisema, "Kwa sababu mimi si mkono, mimi si wa mwili," je, kwa sababu hiyo umeacha kuwa wa mwili?
sw.B: Tuseme mguu unasema, "Mimi si mkono, kwa hiyo mimi si sehemu ya mwili." Je, hilo lingeufanya usiwe sehemu ya mwili?
sw.R: Tuseme mguu ungesema, "Mimi si mkono, kwa hiyo mimi si sehemu ya mwili." Bado ungekuwa sehemu ya mwili!

decisions.choice: a question that expects the answer: it still belongs to the body
alternatives: a statement: it does not for that reason stop belonging to the body
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates this as a question; the two negatives together mean that saying so changes nothing. Read as a statement, the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the foot speaks for believers who feel their gift makes them less a part of the church
decisions.reason: The foot compares itself with the hand and decides it does not belong. Verses 15-20 answer members who feel inferior; verses 21-26 answer those who look down on others.

decisions.choice: It would still be part of the body!
alternatives: Would it belong to the body any less?
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer the question expects (m1).

decisions.choice: je, kwa sababu hiyo umeacha kuwa wa mwili?
alternatives: si kwa sababu hiyo kwamba si wa mwili
decisions.reason: The Greek double negative cannot be copied in Swahili; the question is put so that it expects the answer the meaning decision gives, that the foot still belongs to the body.

source.text: καὶ ἐὰν εἴπῃ τὸ οὖς· Ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ ὀφθαλμός, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος, οὐ παρὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σώματος·

records.literal_gloss: And if should say the ear, Because not I am eye, not I am of the body, not because of this not is it of the body;

en.L: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I am not of the body," it is not for that reason not of the body.
en.B: And if the ear says, "I am not an eye, so I do not belong to the body," it does not belong to the body any less for that.
en.R: Or suppose the ear said, "I am not an eye, so I am not part of the body." It would still be part of the body.

fr.L: Et si l’oreille dit : « Parce que je ne suis pas un œil, je ne suis pas du corps », elle n’en est pas moins du corps pour autant.
fr.B: Et si l’oreille dit : « Je ne suis pas un œil, donc je ne fais pas partie du corps », elle n’en fait pas moins partie du corps pour autant.
fr.R: Ou imaginez que l’oreille dise : « Je ne suis pas un œil, alors je ne fais pas partie du corps. » Elle ferait quand même partie du corps.

es.L: Y si dijera la oreja: «Porque no soy ojo, no soy del cuerpo», no por eso deja de ser del cuerpo.
es.B: Y si la oreja dijera: «Como no soy ojo, no pertenezco al cuerpo», no por eso dejaría de pertenecer al cuerpo.
es.R: O supongamos que la oreja dijera: «No soy un ojo, así que no soy parte del cuerpo». Seguiría siendo parte del cuerpo.

sw.L: Na sikio likisema, "Kwa sababu mimi si jicho, mimi si wa mwili," kwa sababu hiyo halijaacha kuwa la mwili.
sw.B: Na sikio likisema, "Mimi si jicho, kwa hiyo mimi si sehemu ya mwili," hilo haliliondoi katika mwili.
sw.R: Au tuseme sikio lingesema, "Mimi si jicho, kwa hiyo mimi si sehemu ya mwili." Bado lingekuwa sehemu ya mwili.

decisions.choice: it is not for that reason any less part of the body
decisions.reason: Verse 16 repeats verse 15, but the SBLGNT ends it with a raised dot rather than a question mark, so it reads as a statement. The meaning is the same: the ear still belongs.

decisions.choice: the ear and the eye: parts that seem to matter less and more
decisions.reason: The ear compares itself with the eye, the part people value most. As with the foot and the hand, the comparison does not change its place in the body.

source.text: εἰ ὅλον τὸ σῶμα ὀφθαλμός, ποῦ ἡ ἀκοή;

records.literal_gloss: If whole the body [were] eye, where the hearing?

en.L: If the whole body [were] an eye, where [would] the hearing [be]?
en.B: If the body were nothing but an eye, how would it hear?
en.R: If the body were only an eye, it could not hear.

fr.L: Si le corps entier [était] œil, où [serait] l’ouïe ?
fr.B: Si le corps n’était qu’un œil, comment entendrait-il ?
fr.R: Si le corps n’était qu’un œil, il ne pourrait pas entendre.

es.L: Si todo el cuerpo [fuera] ojo, ¿dónde [estaría] el oído?
es.B: Si todo el cuerpo fuera ojo, ¿cómo oiría?
es.R: Si el cuerpo fuera solo un ojo, no podría oír.

sw.L: Kama mwili wote [ungekuwa] jicho, kusikia [kungekuwa] wapi?
sw.B: Kama mwili wote ungekuwa jicho tu, ungesikiaje?
sw.R: Kama mwili ungekuwa jicho tu, usingeweza kusikia.

decisions.choice: hearing: the sense of hearing
decisions.reason: ἀκοή; is hearing, and so the ear that hears. Paul's point is that a body that was all eye would lack something it needs.

decisions.choice: it could not hear
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer to the question instead of asking it.

source.text: εἰ ὅλον ἀκοή, ποῦ ἡ ὄσφρησις;

records.literal_gloss: If whole [were] hearing, where the smelling?

en.L: If the whole [were] hearing, where [would] the smelling [be]?
en.B: If it were all ear, what would it smell with?
en.R: If it were only an ear, it could not smell.

fr.L: Si tout [était] ouïe, où [serait] l’odorat ?
fr.B: S’il n’était qu’une oreille, avec quoi sentirait-il les odeurs ?
fr.R: S’il n’était qu’une oreille, il ne pourrait pas sentir les odeurs.

es.L: Si todo [fuera] oído, ¿dónde [estaría] el olfato?
es.B: Si todo fuera oído, ¿con qué olería?
es.R: Si fuera solo un oído, no podría oler.

sw.L: Kama wote [ungekuwa] kusikia, kunusa [kungekuwa] wapi?
sw.B: Kama wote ungekuwa sikio tu, ungenusa kwa kitu gani?
sw.R: Kama ungekuwa sikio tu, usingeweza kunusa.

decisions.choice: if the whole [body were] hearing
decisions.reason: ὅλον stands without "body", which carries over from the question before.

decisions.choice: ear
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the part, as the question about the eye does.

source.text: νυνὶ δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἔθετο τὰ μέλη, ἓν ἕκαστον αὐτῶν, ἐν τῷ σώματι καθὼς ἠθέλησεν.

records.literal_gloss: But now the God placed the members, one each of them, in the body as he wanted.

en.L: But now God placed the members, each single one of them, in the body just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wished.
en.B: But as things are, God has arranged each and every part in the body as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw fit.
en.R: But God put each part of the body just where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wanted it.

fr.L: Mais maintenant, Dieu a placé les membres, chacun d’eux, dans le corps comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a voulu.
fr.B: Mais en réalité, Dieu a disposé chacune des parties dans le corps comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a jugé bon.
fr.R: Mais Dieu a mis chaque partie du corps exactement là où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le voulait.

es.L: Pero ahora Dios puso los miembros, cada uno de ellos, en el cuerpo como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso.
es.B: Pero lo cierto es que Dios ha colocado cada una de las partes en el cuerpo como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso.
es.R: Pero Dios puso cada parte del cuerpo justo donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quería.

sw.L: Lakini sasa Mungu aliviweka viungo, kila kimoja chake, katika mwili kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyotaka.
sw.B: Lakini kama mambo yalivyo, Mungu amepanga kila sehemu katika mwili kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyoona inafaa.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu aliweka kila sehemu ya mwili mahali hasa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alipotaka.

decisions.choice: but now: but as it is, in reality
decisions.reason: νυνὶ here is logical, not about time: it turns from the absurd "if" of verses 17 to what is actually so.

decisions.choice: God placed each part as he chose
decisions.reason: God's will decides where each part goes, as the Spirit's will decides the gifts (verse 11). The same verb ἔθετο returns in verse 28: God placed people in the church.

source.text: εἰ δὲ ἦν τὰ πάντα ἓν μέλος, ποῦ τὸ σῶμα;

records.literal_gloss: If but were the all one member, where the body?

en.L: And if they were all one member, where [would] the body [be]?
en.B: If the whole were one single part, what kind of body would that be?
en.R: If all the parts were the same, there would be no body.

fr.L: Et si tous étaient un seul membre, où [serait] le corps ?
fr.B: Si l’ensemble n’était qu’une seule partie, quel corps cela ferait-il ?
fr.R: Si toutes les parties étaient pareilles, il n’y aurait pas de corps.

es.L: Y si todos fueran un solo miembro, ¿dónde [estaría] el cuerpo?
es.B: Si todo fuera una sola parte, ¿qué clase de cuerpo sería ese?
es.R: Si todas las partes fueran iguales, no habría cuerpo.

sw.L: Na kama vyote vingekuwa kiungo kimoja, mwili [ungekuwa] wapi?
sw.B: Kama sehemu zote zingekuwa sehemu moja tu, huo ungekuwa mwili wa namna gani?
sw.R: Kama sehemu zote zingefanana, pasingekuwa na mwili.

decisions.choice: where would the body be?: there would be no body at all
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer that one part alone is not a body.

decisions.choice: there would be no body
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer instead of the question.

source.text: νῦν δὲ πολλὰ μὲν μέλη, ἓν δὲ σῶμα.

records.literal_gloss: Now but many on the one hand members, one but body.

en.L: But now [there are] many members, but one body.
en.B: As it is, the parts are many, but the body is one.
en.R: So there are many parts, but they make up only one body.

fr.L: Mais maintenant, [il y a] beaucoup de membres, mais un seul corps.
fr.B: En réalité, les parties sont nombreuses, mais le corps est un.
fr.R: Il y a donc beaucoup de parties, mais elles ne forment qu’un seul corps.

es.L: Pero ahora [hay] muchos miembros, pero un solo cuerpo.
es.B: Lo cierto es que las partes son muchas, pero el cuerpo es uno solo.
es.R: Así que hay muchas partes, pero forman un solo cuerpo.

sw.L: Lakini sasa [kuna] viungo vingi, lakini mwili mmoja.
sw.B: Kama ilivyo, sehemu ni nyingi, lakini mwili ni mmoja.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo kuna sehemu nyingi, lakini zinaunda mwili mmoja tu.

decisions.choice: but now: as things really are
decisions.reason: As in verse 18, νῦν turns from the impossible case to reality. The verse sums up verses 14-19.

source.text: οὐ δύναται δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς εἰπεῖν τῇ χειρί· Χρείαν σου οὐκ ἔχω, ἢ πάλιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῖς ποσίν· Χρείαν ὑμῶν οὐκ ἔχω·

records.literal_gloss: Not is able but the eye to say to the hand, Need of you not I have, or again the head to the feet, Need of you not I have;

en.L: And the eye cannot say to the hand, "I have no need of you," or again the head to the feet, "I have no need of you."
en.B: So the eye cannot tell the hand, "I can do without you," and the head cannot tell the feet, "I can do without you."
en.R: An eye cannot tell a hand, "I can get along without you." A head cannot tell the feet, "I can get along without you."

fr.L: Et l’œil ne peut pas dire à la main : « Je n’ai pas besoin de toi », ni encore la tête aux pieds : « Je n’ai pas besoin de vous. »
fr.B: L’œil ne peut donc pas dire à la main : « Je peux me passer de toi », ni la tête dire aux pieds : « Je peux me passer de vous. »
fr.R: Un œil ne peut pas dire à une main : « Je peux très bien vivre sans toi. » Une tête ne peut pas dire aux pieds : « Je peux très bien vivre sans vous. »

es.L: Y no puede el ojo decir a la mano: «No tengo necesidad de ti», ni tampoco la cabeza a los pies: «No tengo necesidad de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.B: Así que el ojo no puede decirle a la mano: «No te necesito», ni la cabeza puede decirles a los pies: «No {{plural_you:los|os}} necesito».
es.R: Un ojo no puede decirle a una mano: «Puedo arreglármelas sin ti». Una cabeza no puede decirles a los pies: «Puedo arreglármelas sin {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».

sw.L: Na jicho haliwezi kuuambia mkono, "Sina haja nawe," wala tena kichwa [hakiwezi kuiambia] miguu, "Sina haja nanyi."
sw.B: Kwa hiyo jicho haliwezi kuuambia mkono, "Naweza kuishi bila wewe," wala kichwa hakiwezi kuiambia miguu, "Naweza kuishi bila ninyi."
sw.R: Jicho haliwezi kuuambia mkono, "Naweza kuendelea vizuri bila wewe." Kichwa hakiwezi kuiambia miguu, "Naweza kuendelea vizuri bila ninyi."

decisions.choice: the parts that think themselves important cannot do without the others
decisions.reason: Verses 15-16 answered parts that felt they did not belong. Now Paul turns to parts that look down on others, as some in Corinth looked down on those without the gifts they prized.

decisions.choice: you, then you all: one hand, then both feet
decisions.reason: σου is singular and ὑμῶν plural, matching the hand and the feet.

decisions.choice: I can do without you (B); I can get along without you (R)
alternatives: I have no need of you
decisions.reason: The same words for both sayings, as in the Greek.

decisions.choice: ti ... {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}
decisions.reason: The eye speaks to one hand, then the head to both feet (m2), so Spanish says "tú" and then the plural, which takes the ustedes/vosotros setting like every plural "you".

decisions.choice: nawe ... nanyi; wewe ... ninyi
decisions.reason: Swahili, like the Greek, has a singular "you" for the one hand and a plural for the two feet, so the difference the meaning decision notes is kept.

source.text: ἀλλὰ πολλῷ μᾶλλον τὰ δοκοῦντα μέλη τοῦ σώματος ἀσθενέστερα ὑπάρχειν ἀναγκαῖά ἐστιν, καὶ ἃ δοκοῦμεν ἀτιμότερα εἶναι τοῦ σώματος, τούτοις τιμὴν περισσοτέραν περιτίθεμεν, καὶ τὰ ἀσχήμονα ἡμῶν εὐσχημοσύνην περισσοτέραν ἔχει, τὰ δὲ εὐσχήμονα ἡμῶν οὐ χρείαν ἔχει.

records.literal_gloss: But much rather the seeming members of the body weaker to be necessary are, \v 23 and which we think less honorable to be of the body, to these honor greater we put around, and the unpresentable [parts] of us presentability greater have, \v 24 the but presentable [parts] of us not need have.

en.L: On the contrary, much more the members of the body that seem to be weaker are necessary, \v 23 and [the parts] of the body that we think to be less honorable, on these we put greater honor, and our [parts] not fit to be seen have greater dignity, \v 24 but our [parts] fit to be seen have no need [of it].
en.B: Quite the reverse. The parts of the body that seem weaker are all the more necessary. \v 23 The parts we think deserve less honor are the very ones we clothe with greater honor, and the parts we do not show are covered with greater care for decency, \v 24 while the parts we can show need no such care.
en.R: In fact, the parts of the body that seem weaker are the ones we need even more. \v 23 The parts we think are less important are the ones we honor most. We take extra care to cover the private parts of our body, \v 24 but the parts that others see do not need this care.

fr.L: Bien au contraire, les membres du corps qui paraissent être plus faibles sont bien plus nécessaires, \v 23 et [les parties] du corps que nous pensons être moins honorables, nous les entourons d’un plus grand honneur, et nos [parties] peu présentables ont une plus grande dignité, \v 24 tandis que nos [parties] présentables n’en ont pas besoin.
fr.B: Bien au contraire : les parties du corps qui semblent plus faibles sont d’autant plus nécessaires. \v 23 Celles que nous jugeons moins dignes d’honneur, ce sont justement celles que nous entourons de plus d’honneur, et celles que nous ne montrons pas, nous les couvrons avec plus de soin, par décence, \v 24 alors que celles que nous pouvons montrer n’ont pas besoin de ce soin.
fr.R: En fait, les parties du corps qui semblent plus faibles sont celles dont nous avons le plus besoin. \v 23 Les parties que nous trouvons moins importantes sont celles que nous honorons le plus. Nous prenons grand soin de couvrir les parties intimes de notre corps, \v 24 mais les parties que les autres voient n’ont pas besoin de ce soin.

es.L: Al contrario, mucho más los miembros del cuerpo que parecen ser más débiles son necesarios, \v 23 y [las partes] del cuerpo que consideramos menos honrosas, a estas las rodeamos de mayor honra, y nuestras [partes] impresentables tienen mayor decoro, \v 24 pero nuestras [partes] presentables no tienen necesidad [de ello].
es.B: Todo lo contrario. Las partes del cuerpo que parecen más débiles son aún más necesarias. \v 23 Las partes que consideramos menos dignas de honra son precisamente las que vestimos con más honra, y las partes que no mostramos las cubrimos con mayor cuidado por decoro, \v 24 mientras que las partes que se pueden mostrar no necesitan ese cuidado.
es.R: De hecho, las partes del cuerpo que parecen más débiles son las que más necesitamos. \v 23 Las partes que creemos menos importantes son las que más honramos. Tenemos especial cuidado en cubrir las partes íntimas de nuestro cuerpo, \v 24 pero las partes que los demás ven no necesitan ese cuidado.

sw.L: Kinyume chake, zaidi sana viungo vya mwili vinavyoonekana kuwa dhaifu zaidi ni vya lazima, \v 23 na [vile] vya mwili tunavyodhani kuwa na heshima ndogo, hivyo tunavivika heshima zaidi, na [viungo] vyetu visivyofaa kuonekana vina staha zaidi, \v 24 lakini [viungo] vyetu vinavyofaa kuonekana havina haja [ya hiyo].
sw.B: Badala yake, sehemu za mwili zinazoonekana kuwa dhaifu zaidi ndizo za lazima zaidi. \v 23 Sehemu tunazodhani zinastahili heshima ndogo ndizo hasa tunazozivika kwa heshima zaidi, na sehemu tusizozionyesha hufunikwa kwa uangalifu zaidi kwa ajili ya staha, \v 24 wakati sehemu tunazoweza kuzionyesha hazihitaji uangalifu huo.
sw.R: Kwa kweli, sehemu za mwili zinazoonekana kuwa dhaifu ndizo tunazozihitaji zaidi. \v 23 Sehemu tunazodhani si muhimu sana ndizo tunazoziheshimu zaidi. Tunakuwa waangalifu zaidi kufunika sehemu za siri za mwili wetu, \v 24 lakini sehemu ambazo wengine huziona hazihitaji uangalifu huo.

decisions.choice: on the contrary, all the more: far from being unneeded, the weaker parts are needed most
decisions.reason: ἀλλὰ answers the eye and head of verse 21, and πολλῷ μᾶλλον strengthens the point.

decisions.choice: seem to be weaker: parts that look frail or unimportant
decisions.reason: δοκοῦντα stresses appearance: they only seem weaker. Paul does not say which parts he means; the soft inner organs or the eyes, which cannot defend themselves, are possible.

decisions.choice: less honorable and unpresentable parts: the parts of the body people keep covered, above all the sexual organs
decisions.reason: περιτίθεμεν means to put something around, as clothing is put on. People honor the parts they think least of by clothing them with care, while the face and hands go uncovered. Paul speaks of this modestly and so does the translation.

decisions.choice: unpresentable, presentability, presentable: a play on words about what is fit to be seen
decisions.reason: ἀσχήμονα and εὐσχήμονα are opposites, and εὐσχημοσύνην is the noun from the same root: decency, propriety. The point is that the parts thought shameful receive more care.

decisions.choice: the picture applies to members of the church whose gifts seem less important
decisions.reason: Paul is preparing to say that God gives more honor to those who lack it (verse 24). The members of the church who seem weakest are needed, and deserve honor.

decisions.choice: [parts] not fit to be seen / fit to be seen (L); the parts we do not show / can show (B); the private parts of our body / the parts that others see (R)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the contrast between what is covered and what is shown (m4) in plain and modest words (m3).

decisions.choice: impresentables, decoro, presentables
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on one word family for what is fit to be seen (m4). Literal keeps the play with "impresentables" and "presentables", and "decoro" for the noun; Balanced and Readable say what is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: visivyofaa kuonekana, staha, vinavyofaa kuonekana (L); tusizozionyesha, staha, tunazoweza kuzionyesha (B); sehemu za siri (R)
decisions.reason: "Staha" (decency, modesty) carries the play on what is fit to be seen; Readable names the private parts with the usual polite Swahili phrase "sehemu za siri".

source.text: ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς συνεκέρασεν τὸ σῶμα, τῷ ὑστεροῦντι περισσοτέραν δοὺς τιμήν, ἵνα μὴ ᾖ σχίσμα ἐν τῷ σώματι, ἀλλὰ τὸ αὐτὸ ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων μεριμνῶσι τὰ μέλη.

records.literal_gloss: But the God blended together the body, to the [part] lacking greater having given honor, \v 25 so that not there be division in the body, but the same for one another may care the members.

en.L: But God mixed the body together, having given more honor to the [part] lacking [it], \v 25 so that there may not be a split in the body, but the members may care the same for one another.
en.B: But God has blended the body together and given more honor to the part that falls short, \v 25 so that the body would not be split apart, but its parts would all care for one another alike.
en.R: God put the body together in a way that gives more honor to the parts that need it. \v 25 He did this so that the body would not be divided, and all its parts would care about each other equally.

fr.L: Mais Dieu a composé le corps, en donnant plus d’honneur à [la partie] qui en manquait, \v 25 afin qu’il n’y ait pas de division dans le corps, mais que les membres aient le même souci les uns des autres.
fr.B: Mais Dieu a assemblé le corps en donnant plus d’honneur à la partie qui en manque, \v 25 afin qu’il n’y ait pas de division dans le corps, mais que toutes ses parties prennent un égal soin les unes des autres.
fr.R: Dieu a assemblé le corps de façon à donner plus d’honneur aux parties qui en ont besoin. \v 25 Il a fait cela pour que le corps ne soit pas divisé, et pour que toutes ses parties s’occupent autant les unes des autres.

es.L: Pero Dios combinó el cuerpo, dando mayor honra a [la parte] que carecía [de ella], \v 25 para que no haya división en el cuerpo, sino que los miembros se preocupen por igual los unos por los otros.
es.B: Pero Dios ha armonizado el cuerpo, dando más honra a la parte que menos tenía, \v 25 para que no haya división en el cuerpo, sino que todas sus partes se preocupen por igual unas por otras.
es.R: Dios unió el cuerpo de tal manera que da más honra a las partes que la necesitan. \v 25 Lo hizo así para que el cuerpo no esté dividido, y para que todas sus partes se preocupen unas por otras por igual.

sw.L: Lakini Mungu aliuchanganya mwili pamoja, akikipa heshima zaidi [kiungo] kilichopungukiwa, \v 25 ili pasiwe na mfarakano katika mwili, bali viungo vishughulikiane kwa namna ileile.
sw.B: Lakini Mungu ameuunganisha mwili pamoja, na amekipa heshima zaidi kile kilichopungukiwa, \v 25 ili mwili usigawanyike, bali sehemu zake zote zijaliane kwa usawa.
sw.R: Mungu aliuunda mwili kwa namna ambayo inazipa heshima zaidi sehemu zinazoihitaji. \v 25 Alifanya hivyo ili mwili usigawanyike, na ili sehemu zake zote zijaliane kwa usawa.

decisions.choice: blended together: combined the parts into a single well-balanced whole
decisions.reason: συνεκέρασεν is used of mixing things together, such as wine and water. God made one body out of different parts, each in the right measure.

decisions.choice: division: the same word as for the divisions in the church at Corinth
decisions.reason: σχίσμα is the word Paul used for the splits in the church (1:10; 11:18). The body God made has no such splits; neither should the church.

decisions.choice: the same care for one another: equal concern, each part for the others
decisions.reason: τὸ αὐτὸ means "the same": the parts care for one another alike, without favoring some.

decisions.choice: He did this so that
decisions.reason: Readable begins a new sentence for the purpose and names God as the one who acts.

decisions.choice: división
decisions.reason: The same word as the divisions of 1:10 and 11:18 (m2), so Literal and Balanced say "división" here too.

decisions.choice: mfarakano
decisions.reason: The word Literal used for schisma in 1:10 and 11:18, so the link the meaning decision points out stays visible.

source.text: καὶ εἴτε πάσχει ἓν μέλος, συμπάσχει πάντα τὰ μέλη· εἴτε δοξάζεται μέλος, συγχαίρει πάντα τὰ μέλη.

records.literal_gloss: And whether suffers one member, suffer with [it] all the members; whether is glorified a member, rejoice with [it] all the members.

en.L: And if one member suffers, all the members suffer with [it]; if a member is honored, all the members rejoice with [it].
en.B: If one part is in pain, all the parts share its pain; if one part is honored, all the parts share its joy.
en.R: If one part of the body hurts, all the other parts hurt with it. If one part is honored, all the other parts are glad with it.

fr.L: Et si un membre souffre, tous les membres souffrent avec [lui] ; si un membre est honoré, tous les membres se réjouissent avec [lui].
fr.B: Si une partie souffre, toutes les parties partagent sa souffrance ; si une partie est honorée, toutes les parties partagent sa joie.
fr.R: Si une partie du corps a mal, toutes les autres parties ont mal avec elle. Si une partie est honorée, toutes les autres sont heureuses avec elle.

es.L: Y si un miembro sufre, todos los miembros sufren con [él]; si un miembro es honrado, todos los miembros se alegran con [él].
es.B: Si una parte sufre, todas las partes sufren con ella; si una parte recibe honra, todas las partes comparten su alegría.
es.R: Si una parte del cuerpo sufre, todas las demás partes sufren con ella. Si una parte recibe honra, todas las demás se alegran con ella.

sw.L: Na kiungo kimoja kikiumia, viungo vyote huumia pamoja [nacho]; kiungo kikiheshimiwa, viungo vyote hufurahi pamoja [nacho].
sw.B: Sehemu moja ikiumia, sehemu zote huumia pamoja nayo; sehemu moja ikiheshimiwa, sehemu zote hufurahi pamoja nayo.
sw.R: Sehemu moja ya mwili ikiuma, sehemu nyingine zote huumia pamoja nayo. Sehemu moja ikiheshimiwa, sehemu nyingine zote hufurahi pamoja nayo.

decisions.choice: is glorified: is honored, given honor by others
decisions.reason: δοξάζεται usually means to give glory, and often of God. Here it is used of the honor one part of the body receives, as verses 23-24 speak of honor.

decisions.choice: suffer with, rejoice with: the parts share each other's experience
decisions.reason: Both verbs are compounds with "with": the parts suffer together and rejoice together, as Romans 12:15 tells believers to do.

decisions.choice: honored
decisions.reason: The settled word for this verb is "glorify", but here it means human honor, not glory (m1); every level says "honored".

source.text: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε σῶμα Χριστοῦ καὶ μέλη ἐκ μέρους.

records.literal_gloss: You now are body of Christ and members from part.

en.L: Now you are [the] body of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and members, each for [your] part.
en.B: You are {{christos:Christ's|the Messiah's}} body, and each of you individually is one of its parts.
en.R: Together you are {{christos:Christ's|the Messiah's}} body, and every one of you is a part of that body.

fr.L: Or vous, vous êtes [le] corps du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et [ses] membres, chacun pour [sa] part.
fr.B: Vous êtes le corps du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et chacun de vous en est une partie.
fr.R: Ensemble, vous êtes le corps du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et chacun de vous est une partie de ce corps.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} cuerpo de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, y miembros cada uno en [su] parte.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} el cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, y cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es una de sus partes.
es.R: Juntos, {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} el cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, y cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} es una parte de ese cuerpo.

sw.L: Basi ninyi ni mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na viungo, kila mmoja kwa sehemu [yake].
sw.B: Ninyi ni mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na kila mmoja wenu ni sehemu yake.
